title: The Interplay Between Physical Activity, Protein Consumption, and Sleep Quality in Muscle Protein Synthesis
text: This randomized trial enrolled 42 adults and found a 15 percent improvement in muscle protein synthesis when resistance training, adequate protein consumption, and at least 7 hours of nightly sleep were combined.
